title: Matrix, caching, secrets and env
summary: Run one job many ways, make it fast, and keep credentials out of logs.

steps.title: The matrix
body: `strategy.matrix` runs **one job definition once per combination** of values, in parallel:
2 × 2 = 4 jobs. `fail-fast: false` lets the others finish when one fails, so you see every broken combination at once.

steps.prompt: A matrix has `os: [ubuntu, windows, macos]` and `dotnet: ['8.0.x', '9.0.x']` and one `exclude` entry `{os: macos, dotnet: '8.0.x'}`. How many jobs run?

steps.title: Caching
body: Every job starts on a clean machine, so `dotnet restore` downloads every NuGet package every time. A **cache** saves a folder at the end of
a job and restores it at the start of the next run:
- `key` changes whenever the lock file changes, so a dependency update gets a fresh cache.
- On a miss, `restore-keys` are tried as **prefixes**: the most recent cache starting with `Linux-nuget-` is restored, which is
usually close enough, and restore only fetches the difference.
A cache is an optimisation. A build must still succeed with no cache at all.

steps.prompt: Caches stored (oldest first): `Linux-nuget-aaa`, `Linux-nuget-bbb`, `Windows-nuget-ccc`. A Linux run computes key `Linux-nuget-ddd` with restore-key `Linux-nuget-`. Which cache is restored?
steps.explain: No exact hit, so the prefix is tried and the newest matching cache wins.

steps.title: Secrets and env
body: **Secrets** are encrypted values set in repo/org/environment settings, read with `${{ secrets.NAME }}`. **env** sets ordinary variables.
environment: production   # unlocks this environment's secrets
DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}   # step level: narrowest scope
- GitHub **masks** secret values in logs as `***`, but only exact matches. Base64-encode a secret and the mask no longer applies.
- Workflows triggered by pull requests **from forks** get no secrets, so a stranger's PR cannot print them.
- Pass secrets via `env:` rather than pasting `${{ secrets.X }}` inline into a `run:` script.

items: the NuGet API key used to push packages
the production database connection string with password
the public URL of the staging site, shared by many workflows
a cloud service principal's client secret

steps.prompt: Complete the cache step so the key changes when any lock file changes.
steps.explain: `hashFiles` returns a hash of the matched files' contents, so the key follows your dependencies.

steps.title: Expand a matrix
prompt: Write `List<string> Expand(List<(string Key, List<string> Values)> axes)` that returns every combination as `"key=value,key=value"`,
varying the **last** axis fastest (the first axis is the outer loop, like GitHub).
starter: List<string> Expand(List<(string Key, List<string> Values)> axes)
solution: List<string> Expand(List<(string Key, List<string> Values)> axes)
hints: Start with a list holding one empty combination.
For each axis, replace the list with every old combination extended by every value of the axis.
template: Dojo.Eq("one axis", new List<string> { "node=18", "node=20", "node=22" }, Expand(new() { ("node", new() { "18", "20", "22" }) }));
Dojo.Eq("3 axes make 8 jobs", 8, Expand(new() { ("a", new() { "1", "2" }), ("b", new() { "x", "y" }), ("c", new() { "p", "q" }) }).Count);

steps.title: Restore a cache
prompt: Write `string? Restore(string key, List<string> restoreKeys, List<string> cached)` modelling `actions/cache`. `cached` is ordered oldest first.
2. Otherwise try each restore key **in order**; for the first one that any cache name starts with, return the **newest** such cache.
starter: string? Restore(string key, List<string> restoreKeys, List<string> cached)
solution: string? Restore(string key, List<string> restoreKeys, List<string> cached)
hints: Return as soon as one prefix finds something.
template: Dojo.Eq("prefix picks newest", "Linux-nuget-bbb", Restore("Linux-nuget-zzz", new() { "Linux-nuget-" }, dojoC));
Dojo.Eq("restore keys are tried in order", "Windows-nuget-ccc", Restore("Windows-nuget-new", new() { "Windows-nuget-", "Linux-" }, dojoC));
Dojo.Check("cold start returns null", Restore("macOS-nuget-1", new() { "macOS-" }, dojoC) == null, "expected null");
